env.description: Bearer token for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Community Plugins → Local REST API).

env.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).

env.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL
env.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Milliseconds one request attempt (headers and body) may take before it fails with obsidian_timeout. GET, PUT, and DELETE retry a timed-out attempt; all the requests of one tool call share a 45 s budget, or this value when it is longer.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
env.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
env.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; backslashes read as slashes, repeated and trailing slashes and '.' segments dropped, and names normalized to Unicode NFC; an entry naming the vault root ('.') is rejected at startup. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
env.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault, or the read scope when reads are restricted; paths in OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS stay denied. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS
env.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative paths withheld from reads and writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Wins over both allowlists; denied paths are left out of listings, search results, and tag counts. Unset = nothing denied. Example: 'private/,journal/therapy/'.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
env.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_DELETE_ELICITATION
env.description: Opt-in delete confirmation. When true, obsidian_delete_note asks the user to confirm each delete through an elicitation round (the client must support elicitation), and HTTP startup requires a stateful session unless OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true disables the tool. Off by default — the delete runs on the first call, bounded by OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS and OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_OMNISEARCH_URL
env.description: Override URL for the Omnisearch plugin HTTP server. Unset derives from OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL host with port 51361. Required only if the Omnisearch plugin is not on the default port. Under OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS or OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS the URL is never called and the omnisearch search mode is withheld.
